title: ragr-eval — live answers
description: How good are the answers real users get? Live chat turns, scored by the judge in the background.

target.rawSql: SELECT h.created_at AS "time", 'Indexed ' || COALESCE(m.filename, 'a document since deleted') AS "text", 'ingest' AS "tags" FROM public.document_metadata_history h LEFT JOIN public.document_metadata m ON m.id = h.document_metadata_id WHERE h.status = 'INDEXED' AND $__timeFilter(h.created_at)

panels.title: Chat turns
panels.description: Chat turns in the time range, and the share where the search returned passages for the prompt. Turns with none (small talk, questions the documents do not cover) are not scored on the answer. Passages found does not mean the answer used them - that is Backed by sources (Faithfulness).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Turns", AVG(CASE WHEN t.grounded THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.grounded THEN 0.0 END) AS "Passages found (Retrieved)" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}')

panels.title: Did users get a good answer?
panels.description: Judged correct: the judge found the answer on topic, complete, backed by its sources and free of made-up citations. Thumbs up: share of rated answers rated up. Asked again: share of answers followed within 5 minutes by a near-identical question - a silent thumbs down. Example target: End-to-end success above 0.7.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN t.answer_ok THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.answer_ok THEN 0.0 END) AS "Judged correct (End-to-end success)", (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN f.rating = 'UP' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FROM eval.eval_feedback f WHERE $__timeFilter(f.submitted_at)) AS "Thumbs up (User satisfaction)", AVG(CASE WHEN t.rephrased THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.rephrased THEN 0.0 END) AS "Asked again (Implicit thumbs down)", COUNT(t.answer_ok) AS "Answers judged", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eval.eval_feedback f WHERE $__timeFilter(f.submitted_at)) AS "Answers rated" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}')

panels.title: Waiting to be judged (Judge queue)
panels.description: Answers not scored yet. The judge works only while chat is idle, so this grows during busy periods and drains afterwards. An answer waiting over 6 hours is skipped.

panels.title: Quality per hour (End-to-end success)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.occurred_at, '1h'), AVG(CASE WHEN t.answer_ok THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.answer_ok THEN 0.0 END) AS "Judged correct (End-to-end success)", AVG(CASE WHEN t.retrieval_ok THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.retrieval_ok THEN 0.0 END) AS "Found a useful passage (Retrieval hit)" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}') AND t.grounded GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Hourly share of judged answers that were correct, and of turns where a useful passage reached the prompt. Placed at when the question was asked, not when it was judged.

panels.title: Retrieval - did the search find the right passages? (Recall@K, Precision@K, MRR, NDCG)
Search quality (Retrieval metrics)
panels.description: The judge grades each of the 10 passages the search returned. Useful passages used: of the useful ones, the share that reached the prompt. Prompt that was useful: share of the prompt's passages that were useful. Useful passage on top (MRR): 1 when the first passage was useful, 1/2 when the second was, and so on. Ranking quality (NDCG): like MRR, but counts every useful passage, weighted by how high it sits. Example targets: Recall above 0.8, Precision and MRR above 0.6, NDCG above 0.7 - a guide only, since the judge is the same small model that answers.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(t.recall_at_k) AS "Useful passages used (Recall@K)", AVG(t.precision_at_k) AS "Prompt that was useful (Precision@K)", AVG(t.mrr) AS "Useful passage on top (MRR)", AVG(t.ndcg_at_k) AS "Ranking quality (NDCG@K)", COUNT(t.recall_at_k) AS "Turns scored" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}')

panels.title: Are the search settings too strict? (top-k, threshold)
panels.description: Useful passage left out: one was found, but the similarity threshold or top-k kept it out of the prompt - if this is often above zero, loosen one of them. Nothing useful found: the documents do not cover the question. All useful passages cut: no passage reached the prompt although a useful one was found.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN t.relevant_cut_off IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE WHEN t.relevant_cut_off > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) END) AS "Useful passage left out", AVG(CASE WHEN t.relevant_in_pool IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE WHEN t.relevant_in_pool = 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) END) AS "Nothing useful found", AVG(CASE WHEN NOT t.grounded AND t.relevant_in_pool IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE WHEN NOT t.grounded AND t.relevant_in_pool > 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) END) AS "All useful passages cut", AVG(t.retrieval_millis) AS "Search time (Retrieval latency)" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}')

panels.title: Search quality per hour (Retrieval metrics)
panels.description: The panel on the left, averaged per hour.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.occurred_at, '1h'), AVG(t.recall_at_k) AS "Useful passages used (Recall@K)", AVG(t.precision_at_k) AS "Prompt that was useful (Precision@K)", AVG(t.mrr) AS "Useful passage on top (MRR)", AVG(t.ndcg_at_k) AS "Ranking quality (NDCG@K)" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Generation - is the answer itself good? (Faithfulness, Answer relevance, Completeness, Citation correctness)
Answer quality (Generation metrics)
panels.description: Over answers that had passages in the prompt. Backed by sources: share of the answer's statements the passages support. On topic and Complete: the judge's verdicts. Citations check out: cited pages that really say what the sentence claims. Citations to shown pages: cited pages that were in the prompt - checked by code on every answer, not by the judge. Example targets: Faithfulness and Citation support above 0.8.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(t.faithfulness) AS "Backed by sources (Faithfulness)", AVG(CASE WHEN t.relevancy_pass THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.relevancy_pass THEN 0.0 END) AS "On topic (Answer relevance)", AVG(CASE WHEN t.completeness_pass THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.completeness_pass THEN 0.0 END) AS "Complete (Completeness)", SUM(t.citations_supported)::float / NULLIF(SUM(t.citations_checked), 0) AS "Citations check out (Citation support)", SUM(t.citations_valid)::float / NULLIF(SUM(t.citations_emitted), 0) AS "Citations to shown pages (Citation validity)", COUNT(t.faithfulness) AS "Answers judged" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}') AND t.grounded

panels.title: Answer problems
panels.description: All three should stay near zero. Made-up citations: cited pages the model was never shown. Cites nothing: answers that had passages in the prompt but cite no page. Cut off: answers that hit the length limit - the judge reads these as incomplete, so check this first when Complete drops.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(t.citations_fabricated)::float / NULLIF(SUM(t.citations_emitted), 0) AS "Made-up citations (Citation fabrication)", AVG(CASE WHEN t.grounded THEN (CASE WHEN t.citations_emitted = 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) END) AS "Cites nothing (Uncited)", AVG(CASE WHEN t.finish_reason IS NOT NULL THEN (CASE WHEN t.finish_reason = 'length' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) END) AS "Cut off (Truncated)" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}')

panels.title: Answer quality per hour (Generation metrics)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.occurred_at, '1h'), AVG(t.faithfulness) AS "Backed by sources (Faithfulness)", AVG(CASE WHEN t.relevancy_pass THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.relevancy_pass THEN 0.0 END) AS "On topic (Answer relevance)", AVG(CASE WHEN t.completeness_pass THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.completeness_pass THEN 0.0 END) AS "Complete (Completeness)", SUM(t.citations_supported)::float / NULLIF(SUM(t.citations_checked), 0) AS "Citations check out (Citation support)" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}') AND t.grounded GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: The panel on the left, averaged per hour.

panels.title: End to end - did the whole pipeline work? (End-to-end accuracy, Human evaluation, Task-based metrics, User satisfaction)
Where answers go wrong (RAG debugging matrix)
panels.description: Each judged answer placed by two verdicts: did a useful passage reach the prompt, and was the answer correct. The diagnosis says which part to fix.

targets.rawSql: SELECT q.quadrant AS "passages × answer", COUNT(t.turn_id) AS "turns", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(t.turn_id) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(t.turn_id)) OVER (), 0), 0) AS "%", q.diagnosis FROM (VALUES (1, true, true, 'right × right', 'Working well'), (2, true, false, 'right × wrong', 'Generation problem - fix prompt, model or context handling'), (3, false, true, 'wrong × right', 'Partial retrieval, or the judge is wrong'), (4, false, false, 'wrong × wrong', 'Retrieval problem - fix the retriever first')) AS q(ord, r, a, quadrant, diagnosis) LEFT JOIN eval.eval_turn t ON t.retrieval_ok = q.r AND t.answer_ok = q.a AND t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}') GROUP BY q.ord, q.quadrant, q.diagnosis ORDER BY q.ord

panels.title: By kind of question (Task-based metrics)
panels.description: The main measures split by the kind of question the classifier assigned. Ignores the Task filter, so every kind stays visible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(t.task_type, 'unclassified') AS "task", COUNT(*) AS "turns", ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN t.grounded THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.grounded THEN 0.0 END), 0) AS "passages found % (retrieved)", ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN t.answer_ok THEN 1.0 WHEN NOT t.answer_ok THEN 0.0 END), 0) AS "judged correct % (e2e success)", ROUND(AVG(t.faithfulness)::numeric, 2) AS "backed by sources (faithfulness)", ROUND(AVG(t.recall_at_k)::numeric, 2) AS "useful passages used (recall@k)", ROUND(AVG(t.ndcg_at_k)::numeric, 2) AS "ranking quality (NDCG)", COUNT(f.turn_id) FILTER (WHERE f.rating = 'DOWN') AS "thumbs down", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.rephrased) AS "asked again" FROM eval.eval_turn t LEFT JOIN eval.eval_feedback f ON f.turn_id = t.turn_id WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Human verdicts (Human evaluation)
panels.description: Answers a person reviewed (from the review queue below), by verdict. The most trusted accuracy number, but it rests on few answers - see Answers reviewed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN t.human_verdict = 'CORRECT' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Correct (Human accuracy)", AVG(CASE WHEN t.human_verdict = 'PARTIAL' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Partly correct", AVG(CASE WHEN t.human_verdict = 'WRONG' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Wrong", COUNT(*) AS "Answers reviewed" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}') AND t.human_verdict IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Response time (Latency)
panels.description: Answer time: from request to finished answer. First words: streaming endpoint only. With few turns, the slowest 5% is just one or two answers - see Turns.

targets.rawSql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.total_millis) AS "Answer time, median (p50)", percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.total_millis) AS "Answer time, slowest 5% (p95)", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.first_token_millis) AS "First words, median (Time to first token)", AVG(t.retrieval_millis) AS "Search, average (Retrieval latency)", COUNT(t.total_millis) AS "Turns" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}')

panels.title: User feedback per hour (User satisfaction)
panels.description: Thumbs up and down, and questions asked again within 5 minutes. Counts rather than rates, because traffic is low.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(f.submitted_at, '1h'), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.rating = 'UP') AS "thumbs up", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.rating = 'DOWN') AS "thumbs down" FROM eval.eval_feedback f WHERE $__timeFilter(f.submitted_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.occurred_at, '1h'), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.rephrased) AS "asked again" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Can we trust the judge? (Judge calibration)
Does the judge agree with a human reviewer?
panels.description: Answers a person reviewed, compared with the judge's correct / not correct verdict. This decides whether the small local judge is good enough; if agreement stays low, point the judge at a bigger model.

names: Judge failed it, reviewer passed it

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN (t.human_verdict = 'CORRECT') = t.answer_ok THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Agrees with the reviewer (Judge-human agreement)", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.human_verdict <> 'CORRECT' AND t.answer_ok) AS "Judge passed it, reviewer didn't", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.human_verdict = 'CORRECT' AND NOT t.answer_ok) AS "Judge failed it, reviewer passed it", COUNT(*) AS "Answers reviewed" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}') AND t.human_verdict IS NOT NULL AND t.answer_ok IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Does the judge agree with users?
panels.description: Rated answers: thumbs up compared with the judge's verdict. Users also rate tone, length and speed, so expect less agreement than with reviewers. The disagreements are good answers to review.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN (f.rating = 'UP') = t.answer_ok THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Agrees with users (Judge-user agreement)", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.rating = 'DOWN' AND t.answer_ok) AS "Thumbs down, judge passed it", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.rating = 'UP' AND NOT t.answer_ok) AS "Thumbs up, judge failed it", COUNT(*) AS "Answers rated" FROM eval.eval_turn t JOIN eval.eval_feedback f ON f.turn_id = t.turn_id WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}') AND t.answer_ok IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Answers to review (Human review queue)
panels.description: Unreviewed answers worth a person's look: every thumbs down, every case where the user and the judge disagree, and a random 5% sample. Record a verdict (CORRECT, PARTIAL or WRONG) with the command in the last column.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.occurred_at AS "when", CASE WHEN f.rating = 'DOWN' AND t.answer_ok THEN 'thumbs down, judge passed' WHEN f.rating = 'UP' AND NOT t.answer_ok THEN 'thumbs up, judge failed' WHEN f.rating = 'DOWN' THEN 'thumbs down' ELSE 'random sample' END AS "why", t.task_type AS "task", t.query, LEFT(t.answer, 200) AS "answer (truncated)", t.answer_ok AS "judge", f.reason AS "user said", 'curl -X PUT http://localhost:9096/eval/turns/' || t.turn_id || '/review -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d ''{"verdict":"CORRECT"}''' AS "review" FROM eval.eval_turn t LEFT JOIN eval.eval_feedback f ON f.turn_id = t.turn_id WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND t.human_verdict IS NULL AND (f.rating = 'DOWN' OR (f.rating = 'UP' AND NOT t.answer_ok) OR t.review_sample) ORDER BY (f.rating = 'DOWN') DESC NULLS LAST, t.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Failed or partly judged answers
panels.description: Answers the judge failed, or could only partly judge because a step timed out. One column per check, so the failing one stands out. Passage grades: 2 useful, 1 on topic, 0 not useful; prompt passages before the bar.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.occurred_at AS "when", t.task_type AS "task", t.query, t.judge_status AS "judging", t.retrieval_ok AS "retrieval", t.relevancy_pass AS "on topic (answer relevance)", ROUND(t.faithfulness::numeric, 2) AS "backed by sources (faithfulness)", t.completeness_pass AS "complete (completeness)", t.citations_fabricated AS "made-up citations (citation fabrication)", t.citations_supported || '/' || t.citations_checked AS "citations check out (citation support)", (SELECT string_agg(COALESCE(c.judge_grade::text, '?'), ',' ORDER BY c.rank) FILTER (WHERE c.in_context) || ' | ' || COALESCE(string_agg(COALESCE(c.judge_grade::text, '?'), ',' ORDER BY c.rank) FILTER (WHERE NOT c.in_context), '') FROM eval.eval_turn_chunk c WHERE c.turn_id = t.turn_id) AS "passage grades (prompt | unused)", LEFT(t.answer, 160) AS "answer (truncated)" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}') AND (t.answer_ok = false OR t.judge_status = 'PARTIAL') ORDER BY t.occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Judge skips and errors
panels.description: Skipped: answers that waited over 6 hours - a steady rise means the judge cannot keep up, so lower the sample rate. Errors: judge calls that timed out or replied unreadably; that check shows as not measured. Waited for chat: the judge paused because a user was waiting on the same model - expected.

panels.title: Judge time per answer
panels.description: Model time spent scoring each answer, spent only while chat was idle.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(t.judge_millis) FILTER (WHERE t.grounded) AS "Passages found (Retrieved)", AVG(t.judge_millis) FILTER (WHERE NOT t.grounded) AS "No passages found" FROM eval.eval_turn t WHERE t.origin = 'LIVE' AND $__timeFilter(t.occurred_at) AND ('${task}' = 'all' OR t.task_type = '${task}') AND t.judge_status IN ('DONE','PARTIAL')

panels.title: Detail - running totals and search scores
Warning signs (running totals)
panels.description: Totals that should stay flat; they reset when ragr-eval restarts. Refused to answer: a steady climb suggests the prompt wording changed. Repeated the citation rule: the model recited the rule instead of following it. Passages without a citation line: documents indexed before citation lines existed - re-ingest them.

panels.title: Section numbers cited instead of pages (Citation repair)
panels.description: When the model cites a section number where a page belongs, code maps it to a page it was shown when it can. A rising "left as is" line on its own means the model is guessing.

targets.legendFormat: Left as is (counts as made up)

panels.title: Citations by outcome (running total)
panels.description: Every citation, by outcome. Healthy: "valid" climbs while "fabricated" stays flat. Resets when ragr-eval restarts.

panels.title: Share of the prompt the answer cited (Cited context precision)
panels.description: A passage counts as used when the answer cites its page. Mean over every answer since ragr-eval started. Misses passages used without a citation, so compare over time rather than reading the level.

targets.legendFormat: Cited passages near the top (Context precision)

panels.title: Search scores (Similarity)
panels.description: Similarity of the best passage, and the gap between best and worst in the prompt, hourly. A gap shrinking towards zero means the ranking is becoming arbitrary as the corpus grows.

targets.legendFormat: Gap between best and worst (Score spread)
